newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's FIB30 June stock futures hits record high.
newsitem.headline: Italy's FIB30 June stock futures hits record high.

text.p: Italy's FIB30 stock futures June contract reached a record high of 19,320 on Friday, dealers said.
The FIB30 is the futures contract based on the Milan bourse's MIB30 index of Italy's largest quoted stocks.
Futures were boosted by U.S. data on producer prices which fell for the fifth straight month in May, and eased fears of a U.S. interest rate rise next month, dealers added.
The market was also supported by higher domestic bonds and the lira, which were firmer on growing confidence over the start-up of the European single currency.
